slides.title: Customer Satisfaction Analysis 2024
slides.speaker_note: This presentation covers 12 months of customer satisfaction data across all journeys and products, with clear recommendations for improvement.

slides.title: Executive Summary

bullets: Overall customer satisfaction averaged 7.6 over the past year—solid but with clear room for improvement
Maintenance journey achieves highest satisfaction (8.1), setting the benchmark for process excellence
Breakdown journey scores lowest (7.2), driven by waiting times and unclear follow-up communication
Product performance ranges from 7.3 to 8.0, with heat pumps requiring focused attention on planning and communication
Strategic opportunity: replicate Maintenance strengths in underperforming journeys

slides.speaker_note: Key message: We have a proven playbook for high satisfaction (Maintenance), and clear data on where to focus improvement efforts.

slides.title: Satisfaction by Customer Journey
slides.speaker_note: Maintenance sets the gold standard at 8.1. Breakdown lags significantly at 7.2—nearly a full point below. This gap represents our primary improvement opportunity.

slides.title: Satisfaction by Product Category
slides.speaker_note: Maintenance contracts perform strongest, while heat pumps show the most opportunity for improvement. The 0.7-point spread indicates meaningful variation in customer experience.

slides.title: What Drives High Satisfaction

bullets: Maintenance journey scores 8.1 due to clear, proactive communication throughout the process
Customers value predictable scheduling and transparent expectations setting
Technician professionalism and first-time-right execution consistently praised
Maintenance contracts (8.0) benefit from ongoing relationship and familiarity
Success formula: clarity + predictability + communication = satisfaction

slides.speaker_note: Maintenance is our proof point. Customers reward us when we set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and deliver consistently.

slides.title: Critical Improvement Areas

bullets: Breakdown journey (7.2) suffers from excessive waiting times and unclear status updates during resolution
Customer service (7.4) receives praise for friendliness but criticism for long handling times
Heat pump customers (7.3) are satisfied with end results but frustrated by planning delays and communication gaps
Common thread: uncertainty and waiting time erode satisfaction across all pain points
Root cause: operational execution issues, not product or service quality

slides.speaker_note: The problems are operational and fixable. Customers aren't questioning our technical quality—they're frustrated by process inefficiencies and communication gaps.

slides.title: Strategic Assessment

left_column.heading: Our Strengths
items: Maintenance process delivers 8.1 satisfaction through clear communication
Technical quality and end results consistently meet expectations
Customer service teams praised for professionalism and friendliness

right_column.heading: Improvement Opportunities
items: Breakdown response times and status communication require immediate attention
Heat pump planning and scheduling processes need streamlining
Customer service handling times impacting overall experience despite strong interpersonal skills

slides.speaker_note: This is not a product problem or a people problem—it's a process problem. We have the blueprint for success in Maintenance; we need to scale it.

slides.title: Recommended Action Plan

content.recommendation: Implement Maintenance communication playbook across Breakdown and Heat Pump journeys, with immediate focus on status transparency and expectation management
rationale: Maintenance journey proves that proactive communication drives satisfaction—we already know what works
Breakdown and Heat Pump journeys share the same root cause: unclear status updates and uncertain timelines
Customer service handling time can be reduced through process optimization, not headcount increases
next_steps: Deploy Maintenance communication templates to Breakdown teams within 30 days
Implement automated status updates for heat pump planning and installation phases
Conduct process mapping workshop for customer service to identify handling time bottlenecks
Establish monthly KTV monitoring dashboard with journey-specific targets

slides.speaker_note: This recommendation is low-cost and high-impact. We're not inventing new solutions—we're scaling proven practices from Maintenance to underperforming areas.

slides.title: Methodology & Scope

items: Measurement: KTV score (1-10 scale) collected post-interaction
Journeys analyzed: Maintenance, Breakdown, Purchase, Customer Service
Products analyzed: Maintenance contracts, Heat pumps, Solar panels, Boilers
Qualitative feedback: Customer verbatims analyzed for recurring themes

slides.speaker_note: All data validated through customer feedback management system. Minimum sample sizes met for statistical reliability across all segments.
